However, the first appointment I turned up for, I deliberately scheduled before work with time to spare but never got seen  and was kept waiting due to no staff being at work yet, so had to leave after a while. I was told to wait in waiting room... by cleaner ... as there were not staff around when I arrived early in the morning. I was running way behind on time already when I was eventually told by a member of staff that nobody was at work yet and needed to wait longer. There was no one around to tell I had to leave.

I did another e-consult and offered two appointments - an initial and follow up appointment which I couldn't make due to being overseas for a week. The text message specified to reply in the chat to confirm or manage my appointment, so I tried to rebook in the chat but never got a response. I received a message reminding me of my appointment a day or so before, so I  cancelled (confirmed via text and on system) and was again told to put in another e-consult. Since I got back I haven't bothered to try and rebook.

Then today I have received a message saying missing multiple appointments is unacceptable... even though I cancelled and their admin is a mess??

From what I've heard the staff here are good but they really need to think about the system they use to book/communicate with patients as its clearly flawed, and also don't offer appointments you can't staff.

I will not be rebooking and considering moving to private healthcare. Feel like I've wasted my
